Fix Critical: Add missing get_item_count() to InventoryContainer

## Root Cause
The Phase 1-5 refactoring added 5 calls to `loot_container.get_item_count()`
but this method was never implemented in InventoryContainer class.

## Error
```
Invalid call. Nonexistent function ''get_item_count'' in base ''RefCounted (InventoryContainer)''
Location: loot_distribution_screen.gd:301
```

## Investigation
- InventoryContainer extends RefCounted (pure data container)
- Internal storage: Dictionary (UUID → ItemInstance)
- Public API had get_all_items() but no get_item_count()
- Code assumed method existed but it was never added

## Affected Code (5 locations)
1. Line 257 - _populate_loot_container() - immediate crash
2. Line 772 - _on_take_all_pressed() - auto-close check
3. Line 841 - _on_take_rare_pressed() - auto-close check  
4. Line 871 - _update_counters() - UI display
5. Line 914 - _on_leave_pressed() - remaining items check

## Fix
Added 3-line convenience method to InventoryContainer:
```gdscript
func get_item_count() -> int:
    return _items.size()
```

## Impact
- Fixes all 5 crash points
- O(1) performance (dictionary size)
- Makes public API complete and intuitive
- No behavioral changes, just missing method

## Testing
Screen should now:
✅ Load loot without crashing
✅ Display correct item counts
✅ Auto-close when all items taken
✅ Show remaining items on leave
